title: Lying Cable Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low pulley on a cable machine. Lie flat on your back on the floor or a bench.
Grab the rope and hold it with both hands, bringing it to the sides of your head.
Kneel on the floor, and pull the rope slightly to create tension. Keep your feet flat and knees bent at 90 degrees. This is the starting position.
Brace your abs, and pull your torso down towards your knees by crunching your body forward.
Focus on using your core muscles to bend forward, keeping your elbows fixed.
Pause, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Perform the desired number of reps while maintaining control and focusing on your abs.
tips: Use controlled movements. Perform the crunch slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and avoidinjury.
Focus on crunching with your abs, not pulling with your arms. The arms should only guide the rope.
Avoid arching your back too much. Keep the motion in your torso to protect your spine.
Avoid using your hips or legs to assist in the movement. Focus on flexing your spine using your abs.
